app.name: Sports VidIA
app.notConfiguredBody: Create a .env file from .env.example with your Supabase project URL and key, then restart the app.

common.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this? This cannot be undone.

auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.checkEmail: We sent you an email to confirm your account. Open the link and come back here.

club.noClubs: You are not a member of any club yet. Create one, or ask your club administrator to invite you with this email.
club.name: Club name
club.deleteClub: Delete the club and all its data
club.deleteClubConfirm: Type the club name to confirm:

home.phaseNote: You can now create matches and keep the live score: line-ups, points, substitutions, liberos and time-outs. Coding of game actions and video arrive in the next phases.

members.title: Club users
members.inviteHelp: The person must sign up with this email; they will be added to the club automatically when they sign in.
members.lastAdmin: You can't remove the club's only administrator.

players.title: Players
players.imageConsentHelp: Required to upload videos showing this player to YouTube. For minors, consent must come from their legal guardians.
players.privacyNote: For data protection only what statistics need is stored: no date of birth, contact details or photos.
players.numberTaken: That number is already taken in this team.

matches.title: Matches
matches.empty: No matches yet. Create one to get started.
matches.sameTeam: Home and away teams must be different.
matches.needTeams: You need at least two teams (yours and an opponent). Create them under Teams.
matches.noRoster: This team has no roster. Add players from the team's page.
matches.rosterLocked: The match has started: numbers and liberos can no longer change, but you can still add players.
matches.noPlayersCalled: No players selected for this team.
matches.takeOverHelp: As an administrator, you become the coder for this match.
matches.needRoster: Before starting, check both teams’ match rosters.

live.liberoAutoOut: {{team}}: libero {{libero}} leaves and {{player}} returns (moving to the front row).
live.noCandidates: No legal substitution is possible for this player.
live.noLiberoOptions: No libero replacement is possible right now.
live.liberoRules: The libero may only replace back-row players, cannot serve, and must be replaced by the player they replaced. They leave automatically when they would rotate to the front row.
live.lineupIncomplete: Fill in all six positions for each team.
live.lineupHelp: Enter who plays in each position at the start of set {{set}}, as on the score sheet.
live.tiebreakToss: In the deciding set, first serve is decided by a toss.

engine.set_in_play: The set is still in play.
engine.duplicate_player: A number appears twice in the line-up.
engine.libero_in_lineup: The libero cannot be in the starting line-up.
engine.max_subs: All {{max}} substitutions for this set have been used.
engine.max_timeouts: All {{max}} time-outs for this set have been used.
engine.not_libero: {{player}} is not a libero this set.
engine.libero_front_row: The libero cannot replace a front-row player ({{player}}).
engine.libero_cannot_serve: The libero cannot enter at position I while their team is serving.
engine.libero_must_return_for_replaced: When the libero leaves, {{player}} must return.
engine.libero_on_court: A libero is already on court ({{player}}).
engine.sub_libero_replaced: {{player}} is off court for the libero: the libero must leave first.
